2026/27 catalogue 列 module leader 為 Dr A: The 2026/27 catalog lists the module leader as Dr Andrew Maclachlan (Associate Professor in Spatial Data Science and Visualization). In addition to teaching GIS, R, geocomputation, and reproducible spatial analysis, his research cases include telemetry mapping, urban expansion and land cover change, and urban heat islands; a recent example is the combination of IoT sensors and UMEP for high-resolution thermal environment analysis at Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park. The R practical textbook for CASA0005 was also co-developed by MacLachlan and Adam Dennett, but the author of the textbook is not equal to this year's weekly teaching list.

2026/27 Module Catalogue 列 module leader: The 2026/27 Module Catalog lists the module leader as Dr Jens Kandt (UCL Associate Professor in Urban Geography and Data Science). His research spans urban geography, mobility/transport, and how transportation and land use work together to shape cities. Specific examples include research on the transport use and health of the elderly and how bus concessions affect mobility; as well as studies on large-scale transport investments and neighborhood changes.
